extension.description: Development provider for remote Ollama via SSH tunnel
command.connect.title: Ollama: Connect to Remote
command.disconnect.title: Ollama: Disconnect
command.reconnect.title: Ollama: Reconnect
command.changeHost.title: Ollama: Change Remote Host
command.toggleConnectionMode.title: Ollama: Toggle Local / SSH
configuration.title: Ollama Dev
configuration.connectionMode.description: Connection mode for Ollama. Use 'ssh' for remote SSH tunnel or 'local' to connect directly to a local Ollama endpoint.
configuration.localEndpoint.description: When connectionMode is 'local', the HTTP endpoint for Ollama (e.g., http://127.0.0.1:11434).
configuration.remoteHost.description: SSH host for remote Ollama server (e.g., user@192.168.1.100)
configuration.remotePort.description: Port where Ollama is running on the remote server.
configuration.localPort.description: Local port to forward the SSH tunnel to (default 43134 to avoid conflicts with local Ollama).
configuration.sshKeyPath.description: Path to SSH private key (e.g., ~/.ssh/id_ed25519). Leave empty to use the default SSH key.
configuration.inferenceParams.descriptio: Custom inference parameters for Ollama models.
